author: priya-raman
title: Add the settlement matcher
body:
## What

Adds the matcher that pairs settlement lines with ledger entries, plus the `exceptions` table for lines that cannot be paired.

## Why

Finance has been doing this in a spreadsheet every morning. The matcher does it after the nightly import and leaves the hard cases for a human.

## How

- Match by processor reference, then by amount inside the account.
- Anything left over becomes an exception with a reason code (`no_reference`, `amount_mismatch`, `duplicate_reference`).
- The matcher is read-only against the ledger.

## Testing

Unit tests for each reason code. A replay of three weeks of real-shaped sample data matches 99.2% of lines automatically.
